title: Pricing
key_points: itch.io supports 'pay what you want' pricing, where the set price is a minimum price.
The average purchase on itch.io is about $1.50 more than the minimum price.
Setting up sales and bundles can be another way to drive purchases of projects.
Projects can be released as 'early access' with a paywall while still in development.
limitations: The guide only covers options for setting prices, not other types of sales or marketing activities.
asserts: Setting the right price point on itch.io can boost profits and encourage higher-priced donations.
scope: The scope is about how to price projects correctly on the itch.io platform.
